subject: QBR + Roadmap: splitting sessions, recording rights, and backup hosts
messages:
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
To: Avery Collins <avery.collins@vitalityhealth.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 02 Sep 2026 14:12:00 -0700
Subject: QBR + Roadmap: initial ask and two-session proposal

Hi Avery —

Thanks again for the renewal conversation last week. To make the QBR productive for your execs and the engineering stakeholders, can we split the session into two focused blocks: a 45-minute exec roadmap + business outcomes session and a 45-minute technical deep-dive? That keeps things sharp and gives your team targeted takeaways.

Proposed slots (your timezone):
- Option A: Tue Sep 7, 09:30–10:15 (exec) + 10:30–11:15 (tech)
- Option B: Wed Sep 8, 15:00–15:45 (exec) + 16:00–16:45 (tech)

Operational asks:
- Please confirm who will attend the exec slot and whether recording is OK (we can redact any customer-sensitive slides afterwards).
- We’ll bring the QBR agenda and an ops-runbook stub in the invite. Monica will own the runbook.

Attaching a draft agenda so you can see the split. Happy to tighten if you prefer a single 60–75 minute session instead.

Thanks,
Tessa
Tessa Morgan
Account Executive — Renewals & Expansion
Redwood Inference

Date: Fri, 03 Sep 2026 09:04:00 +0100
Subject: Re: QBR + Roadmap: initial ask and two-session proposal

Hi Tessa —

Thanks for the clear options. We like the two-block approach. A few constraints from our side:
- Our Execs (CEO + VP Product) are only available in the mornings CET, but the engineering owners prefer afternoons.
- Recording is fine for the exec portion, but legal wants a note that any patient-identifiable examples must be redacted before distribution.

If possible, can we do the exec session Tue Sep 7 at 09:30 CET and push the tech deep-dive to Wed Sep 8 at 16:00 CET? That gives our engineers time to prep after the exec sync.

Attaching internal attendee list; Samir will join the tech deep-dive.

—Avery
Avery Collins
Senior Director, Partnerships
Vitality Health
